en.headline: Ngok Tou Tou Chinese Musical Club stages Cantonese opera at Ko Shan Theatre tonight
en.dek: The performance of a full-length opera begins at 7:30pm with tickets priced from HK$180 to HK$480.
body: Ngok Tou Tou Chinese Musical Club is presenting a Cantonese opera performance at Ko Shan Theatre this evening.
The show is scheduled for 7:30pm on Thursday at the theatre in Hung Hom. Tickets range from HK$180 to HK$480.

Ko Shan Theatre is a dedicated venue for Cantonese opera, which is recognised as an intangible cultural heritage. The performance is part of the Leisure and Cultural Services Department’s cultural programmes.

zh.headline: 樂滔滔曲藝社今晚高山劇場演出粵劇
zh.dek: 完整粵劇演出於晚上7時30分開始，票價由180至480港元。
body: 樂滔滔曲藝社今晚在高山劇場呈獻粵劇演出。
演出定於周四晚上7時30分在紅磡高山劇場舉行。票價介乎180至480港元。
高山劇場是專為粵劇而設的場地，粵劇被列為非物質文化遺產。是次演出屬康文署文化節目之一。
